response_text: Yes, it will still be functional, but with no purpose. After printing once, the thread will yield and attempt to perform a context switch, however, it will end up simply reloading the same values back into the registers. The function will simply be called again, so while it does not need to “switch context” it will do so to only switch back to itself and resume operations.\n
